bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 70
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT p.chat_id,p.message_thread_id,p.title,p.state,coalesce(string_agg(DISTINCT t.purpose,','),'NO_POSTING_TOPIC'),coalesce(bool_or(t.enabled),FALSE) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins p LEFT JOIN posting_topics t ON t.chat_id=p.chat_id AND t.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id WHERE p.state='verified' AND p.message_id IS NULL AND p.pinned=FALSE GROUP BY p.chat_id,p.message_thread_id,p.title,p.state ORDER BY p.chat_id,p.message_thread_id"
echo MISSING_ENTRY_TITLES_AUDIT_DONE
